[[Roland le Moisson]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Gate of Torment}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Haven't the [[Margonite]]s caused enough trouble? I'll not have them harm my people... not if I can help it! Now, I'm no fighter, but I am wealthy. Let's see if I can turn a bit of my gold to use, shall we? If you retrieve for me 5 [[Margonite Mask]]s, I'll buy you something nice:"''

{{:Roland le Moisson/Collector}}

==Trivia==
*Roland is one of very few living [[human]]s in the whole of the [[Realm of Torment]].
*His surname means "the harvest" in French.
